description: Accumulation-as-form: one continuous body that refuses to section itself, growing slowly louder and brighter over seven unbroken minutes, until the disturbance concentrates into twenty seconds of dark narrow murk at 7:20 — inside which lands the track's loudest transient. Then a loud return and a ten-second dim-out, ending at home in G# minor. The ghost doesn't arrive; it accumulates.
name: ghost_riots

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Quietest and darkest in the track (RMS mean -22.7dB, floor -25.3dB at 0:00; centroid ~1666Hz; MFCC1 -281.42). Muffled opening; the brightness step at ~0:20 is the real start.

sections.name: Body I (first statement)
sections.notes: Brightness steps up at ~0:20 (centroid ~2828Hz) and stays there. First statement of the groove on the long bright plateau. Tempo ~179 BPM.

sections.name: Body II (pitted plateau)
sections.notes: Same plateau, pitted with drop-outs: deepest mid-track dip -22.7dB at 3:30 (peak -7.7, a real cut-out), -19.8/-20.2dB at 5:15-5:20. Never settles, never breaks. Modal rotation: E maj label at 1:30, B maj at 2:30, same seven notes throughout.

sections.name: Climax plateau
sections.notes: Loudest sustained section (RMS mean -13.3dB, -11.5dB at 7:10). Tempo at its fastest here (~192 BPM). No second climax follows — this IS the peak, and the track stays loud after it.

sections.name: The valley (ghost passage)
sections.notes: Twenty seconds of dark narrow murk (centroid 1130-1153Hz, bandwidth 1315-1653Hz) that still contains the track's loudest transient (-0.5dBFS peak at 7:25). RMS whips -19.6/-11.7/-22.2/-20.8dB across four windows — the most volatile passage in the track. Two-staged: dark first (7:20-7:30), then bright-but-quiet.

sections.name: Final body (loud return)
sections.notes: Loud return after the disturbance (RMS mean -13.5dB, -11.6dB at 8:25), brightness back to ~2641Hz. The track re-attains climax level and holds it for nearly a minute — the valley changed nothing.

sections.name: Outro (dim-out)
sections.notes: Ten-second spectral collapse: centroid 2071 -> 1378Hz, rolloff 4395 -> 2835Hz, ~4dB pullback to -15.8dB. No hard cut, no silence. Ends on the tonic (G# min, 0.647) — the track recedes, it doesn't stop.
